top_signals.title: Kochugovindan: US Growth Resilient Despite Energy Shocks
top_signals.summary: Global bonds were selling off again as traders ramped up  bets on further Fed rate hikes after strong US economic data and weak demand at a Treasury auction pushed yields to multi-decade highs. Sree Kochugovindan, Senior Research Economist at Aberdeen Investments spoke to Bloomberg’s Jennifer Zabasajja on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the US growth. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: India Slashes Edible-Oil Duties to Reduce Festival Food Costs
top_signals.summary: India, the top edible-oil buyer, halved import taxes on crude palm and soybean oils to ease local prices heading into the festive season.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Hormuz Supply Crisis to Change LNG Market Forever
top_signals.summary: The Strait of Hormuz crisis has turned roughly 20% of global LNG supply into something buyers now have to treat as interruptible. Nearly seven months after traffic through the strait collapsed, LNG exports from Qatar and the UAE remain severely constrained. Buyers in Europe and Asia are responding by looking for supply that does not depend on Hormuz at all—from Canada, Mozambique, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea and Argentina—and reconsidering how much of their future gas demand they are willing to tie to a single export route. top_signals.summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius has lobbied U.S. defense leaders to allow the production of PAC-3 MSE interceptor missiles in Germany.
